meta.description: A label-and-value row with an optional trailing element, description line and text link — used for inline detail pairs within lists and cards.

verdict.title: Keep — all findings resolved
verdict.text: Rebuilt on node 4419:24515 in the 2026 Working File as Type (Copy Icon · Badge · Checkmark · Slot) × hasDescription × hasTextLink = 16 variants. The enum that hid five compositions is split into orthogonal axes, so clipboard plus description plus link is now a real combination rather than an unreachable one. The trailing element routes through a shared Trailing Elements instance holding a real Badge or DS icon, and every layer carries a distinct semantic name mapping onto §3. All four DS Health traits pass; the only item still open is Code Connect, blocked until the native library exists.

overview.inContextNote: Inline Text is a composition primitive. You'll find stacks of it inside Generic Transaction Card's detail modal, Send Money confirmation screens, receipt summaries, and fee-breakdown list items. Rarely used standalone.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Genuinely reused across transaction cards, modal summaries, and list items. A strong primitive.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Binds tokens cleanly and routes the trailing element through a shared Trailing Elements instance holding a real Badge or DS icon, so styling propagates rather than being redrawn here.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Type × hasDescription × hasTextLink are orthogonal, boolean values are genuine True/False, and every layer carries a distinct semantic name — the text layers mapping onto §3 as Label, Value, Description, plus LinkLabel. Type=Slot is a deliberate, documented choice.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Stacks inside transaction cards, modal summaries and list items, and the three axes combine freely — clipboard plus description plus link is now a real combination rather than an unreachable one. Type=Slot accepts arbitrary trailing content.

behavior.notes: Label leading, value trailing. The baseline receipt row.
Value + 24 × 24 copy icon. Tapping the icon copies the value to clipboard.
Replaces the value with a trailing badge pill. Used for voucher / discount selection.
Adds a second row below the label with secondary caption text.
Second row adds a trailing text link (CTA) next to the description.
Copy icon has no pressed state or success toast hook — users get no feedback when the tap lands.

resolved.headline: type enum split into orthogonal axes.
resolved.body: v2.0: Rebuilt on node 4419:24515 in the 2026 Working File. The single enum that hid five layouts is now Type (Copy Icon · Badge · Checkmark · Slot) × hasDescription × hasTextLink = 16 variants. Trailing-element kind, description presence and link presence are independent, so no combination is unreachable. (C2 · Property)

resolved.headline: Enum values cleaned up.
resolved.body: v2.0: The "with X" phrasing is gone — values are now Copy Icon, Badge, Checkmark and Slot, each naming the trailing element rather than describing a composite layout. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Badge is instance-swapped, not drawn inline.
resolved.body: v2.0: The trailing element goes through a shared Trailing Elements instance which in turn holds a real Badge instance. Badge styling changes now propagate rather than needing to be redrawn here. (C6 · Composition)

resolved.headline: Copy icon uses the shared wrapper.
resolved.body: v2.1: Confirmed by the component owner — Type=Copy Icon routes through the same Trailing Elements instance as Badge rather than drawing the glyph inline, so it inherits the DS icon. (C6)

resolved.headline: Clipboard property renamed to describe the element.
resolved.body: v2.0: The property value now reads Type=Copy Icon, naming what appears rather than the clipboard mechanism behind it. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Layer naming completed.
resolved.body: v2.1: Seven renames — the 16px #label → Label, the 12px link #label → LinkLabel, #amount → Value, description → Description, the two container frames → ValueGroup and DescriptionGroup, and bottom-container → SupportingRow. Resolves the duplicate #label and duplicate container collisions, and the text names now map onto §3 — Label, Value, Description. (C1)

resolved.headline: Row frame renamed to MainRow.
resolved.body: v2.2: The top row no longer shares the component set's own name, pairing cleanly with SupportingRow below it. Every layer this component owns now carries a distinct semantic name. (C1)

resolved.headline: Type=Slot confirmed intentional.
resolved.body: v2.2: Closed by owner decision — Slot stays. The team treats Slot as a first-class concept in the system rather than an implementation detail, so the value reads as a named content mode to anyone working in the library. (C2)

resolved.headline: Pressed state ruled out of scope.
resolved.body: v2.2: Closed by owner decision — nested buttons and links across the system do not currently carry pressed states, so adding one here would make Inline Text the outlier rather than the standard. Revisit at family level if pressed states are introduced for nested interactive elements generally. (C5)

resolved.headline: Stacking and typography documented.
resolved.body: v2.2: Documented rather than deferred. Stacking — rows carry no separator of their own and no vertical padding: a row is 24px tall without a description and 44px with one, at 368 wide. The containing list or card supplies the gap between rows and any dividers, so a run of Inline Text rows sits flush unless the parent spaces them. Typography reconciliation with Generic Transaction Card — the supporting scale is already shared: Description and the card's Metadata are both BarkAda Semibold 12/18 at #6780A9, identical. The primary scale differs deliberately: the card's own title is Proxima Soft Semibold 18/18 while Inline Text's Label and Value are 16/16. That gap is the hierarchy — the card heading sits above the detail rows beneath it — not a drift to correct. (Docs)

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Copy Icon for references and IDs the user needs to paste elsewhere.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t put Copy Icon on an amount or a date.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Badge when the value is a status, and keep the badge text to one word.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use Badge to restyle a plain value.

usageGuidelines.doText: Keep the Label to one line — it shares the 368 px row with the value.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t wrap the label; move the detail into Description.

usageGuidelines.doText: Put a DS icon in the Slot at 24 × 24.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t place text or a second value in the Slot.

scorecard.notes: MainRow / SupportingRow, ValueGroup, DescriptionGroup and the four text layers Label, Value, Description, LinkLabel — read on 4419:20913.
Type with Title Case values; hasDescription and hasTextLink are real True / False booleans.
Label and Value resolve to Primary/Label/Light/Base, Description and LinkLabel to Secondary/Bold/Caption. Colour variable bindings are not readable with the plugin — confirm in Dev Mode.
One enum, two booleans, one slot and four text values — maps 1:1 onto EBInlineText.
No State property: the copy icon and the text link have no pressed or disabled variant in the set.
Copy and Checkmark are icon-library instances inside Trailing Elements; Badge is a Badge instance.

changelog.header: Style and Code tabs re-read · node 4419:24515

rows.body: Style tab rebuilt from the 16 live variants. Cards follow Type — Copy Icon, Badge, Checkmark, Slot — with hasDescription and hasTextLink as panel toggles; colours, text styles and the 44 / 24 heights read off 4419:20913 and the four base variants. Padding, gap, alignment and colour tokens are not readable with the plugin and stay —.

Code tab regrouped on the Type × hasDescription × hasTextLink schema. Installation added on the solo coordinates, Property Mapping is one row per property, Usage Snippets and Guidelines added, Scorecard regraded, Variants Inventory moved from the five type nodes to the 16 live nodes with a summary and full breakdown.

Resolved issues recorded. 10 resolved issues on the Overview tab had no changelog row: type enum split into orthogonal axes; Enum values cleaned up; Badge is instance-swapped, not drawn inline; Copy icon uses the shared wrapper; Clipboard property renamed to describe the element; Layer naming completed; Row frame renamed to MainRow; Type=Slot confirmed intentional; Pressed state ruled out of scope; Stacking and typography documented.
Verdict: Restructure — Replace type enum (5 layouts) with orthogonal booleans + unified trailing slot. Instance-swap Badge. Add pressed state on copy icon. Open
C1 — Type enum hides compositions — 5 type values conflate two axes (trailing slot + sub-row). Split into hasCopy, hasDescription, hasTextLink, unified trailing slot. Open
C2 — "with X" value phrasing — Figma enum values describe what's added, not what the row IS. Rename under boolean-prop schema. Open
C6 — Badge drawn inline — with Badge hardcodes information/light fill + label instead of instance-swapping Badge. Parallel source of truth. Open
C5 — Copy / link pressed states — Copy icon and text link have no pressed tint, focus ring, or success feedback hook. Open
Tokens ✓ — All four semantic color roles (label, label-value, description, label-link) plus icon bound correctly. Noted
C7 — Code Connect — Blocked on restructure. Open
